title: Graphic Designer
description:
About the Company:
 



 Chavara Ad Media is a full service advertising agency headquartered in Kottayam, Kerala. Journalist and ad\-film director Joseph Chavara founded it in 1985\. The agency has more than 40\+ years of experience and is fully INS accredited. It delivers branding, digital marketing, ad films, TV, radio, newspaper advertising, and public relations. Major media outlets has recognised Chavara with a Certificate of Excellence as one of the top contributing agencies in Kerala.
 



 We combine decades of media experience with a young, fast moving creative team of writers, designers, and marketers. Whether the medium is a newspaper page or a social feed, our focus is on ideas that get noticed and campaigns that get results. If you want to grow inside an agency that works across both traditional and modern digital media, this is the place to do it.
 



  





  





 Role Description:
 



 This is a full time, on\-site Graphic Designer role based in Kottayam. We're hiring a creative, detail oriented Graphic Designer to produce visuals for print and digital platforms. You'll turn briefs and ideas into engaging designs that match each client's brand identity and marketing goals. You'll work closely with our social media, content, and marketing teams, present your work to internal teams and clients, and refine it based on feedback. In a fast paced agency environment, you'll also stay current on design trends and tools, including AI\-assisted design and video, to keep our work fresh.
 



  





  





 Key responsibilities
 


* Design social media posts, banners, website visuals, advertisements, brand assets and marketing collateral
* Develop creative concepts with the social media, content, and marketing teams
* Create layouts and templates for digital campaigns that stay consistent and on brand
* Edit video assets for making content in campaigns and social platforms
* Prepare and present design drafts to internal teams and clients, and incorporate feedback quickly
* Make sure every final output is polished and on brand across all platforms
* Keep up with new design trends, tools, and AI workflows



  





  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with experience creating assets for digital and print media.
* Ability to design distinctive logos and develop Branding elements that support cohesive brand identities.
* Proficiency in Typography, including font selection, hierarchy, and readability for various formats.
* Competence with industry standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign or equivalent software).
* Relevant education or training in graphic design, visual communication, or a related field.
* Attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with creative, marketing, and client\-facing teams.
* Strong communication skills and openness to constructive feedback
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, meet tight deadlines, and juggle multiple projects
* Knowledge of current digital marketing and graphic design trends

title: Graphic Designer and Multimedia Specialist
description:
**Role Description:** 




 We are seeking a creative and talented Graphic Designer \& Multimedia Specialist to develop engaging visual content for both digital and print platforms. The ideal candidate will be responsible for graphic design, videography, video editing, social media content creation and management, website design and updates, marketing collateral development, and support for digital marketing activities. The role requires a strong eye for design, creativity, and the ability to produce high\-quality multimedia content that enhances the company's brand image and marketing efforts.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Graphic Design** 



* Design brochures, flyers, catalogs, company profiles, presentations, banners, posters, advertisements, and other marketing materials.
* Create engaging graphics for websites, social media platforms, email campaigns, and digital advertisements.
* Maintain brand consistency across all marketing and communication materials.
* Develop creative concepts and visual solutions for marketing campaigns and corporate communications.
* Multimedia ProductionPlan, capture, and edit photos and videos for promotional, corporate, and social media purposes.
* Produce high\-quality video content including product demonstrations, corporate videos, event coverage, and marketing campaigns.
* Create basic motion graphics, animations, and visual effects when required.
* Manage multimedia projects from concept development through final production.



**Social Media Management** 



* Create, schedule, and publish content across social media platforms.
* Develop creative content ideas and campaigns to increase audience engagement.
* Monitor social media performance and prepare reports on content effectiveness.
* Ensure timely posting and consistency in brand messaging.
* Website Design \& Content ManagementDesign and update website pages, banners, graphics, and multimedia content.
* Ensure website content remains visually appealing, relevant, and up to date.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to maintain website functionality and user experience.
* Digital Marketing Support
* Design digital marketing creatives for online advertising campaigns.
* Assist in email marketing, content marketing, and lead generation initiatives.
* Support SEO and website optimization activities.
* Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.
* Branding \& Corporate CommunicationsSupport branding initiatives and corporate identity development.
* Prepare visual content for exhibitions, events, product launches, and corporate presentations.
* Develop creative assets that strengthen the company's market presence.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Visual Communication, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 2–5 years of experience in graphic design, multimedia production, and content creation.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating graphic design, video editing, and multimedia projects.
* Required SkillsProficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, and After Effects.
* Strong graphic design, visual communication, and branding skills, including logo design and the development of cohesive brand identities.
* Solid understanding of typography, layout, color theory, and visual hierarchy to create engaging digital and print materials.
* Experience in photography, videography, video editing, and motion graphics production.
* Experience in creating and managing content for social media platforms.
* Knowledge of website design and content management systems such as WordPress or similar platforms.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing principles and SEO best practices.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, meet deadlines, and maintain a high level of attention to detail.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams in an on\-site environment.
* A professional portfolio demonstrating graphic design and multimedia work; experience in B2B or industrial sectors is preferred.
* Diploma or bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, or a related field.
* Preferred Skills (Added Advantage)Knowledge of 3D design software such as Blender, Cinema 4D, or 3ds Max.
* Motion graphics and animation experience.
* Basic UI/UX design knowledge.
* Experience with digital advertising platforms.



**Qualifications:** 



* Candidates should possess strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with experience creating visual content for digital and print media.
* Candidates should possess skills in Logo Design and Branding, including developing and maintaining cohesive brand identities.
* Candidates should possess solid Typography skills, with the ability to select and apply typefaces that enhance readability and brand consistency.
* Candidates should have proficiency in industry\-standard design and multimedia tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud, video and motion graphics software).
* Candidates should demonstrate a professional portfolio showcasing relevant design and multimedia work, preferably in B2B or industrial sectors.
* Candidates should have strong attention to detail, time management, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams on\-site.
* A diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, or a related field is preferred; experience in the oil and gas industry is an advantage.



  




* **Employment Type:**
* Full\-Time

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Deutsche is a leading consulting firm that helps organizations manage complexity and drive sustainable growth through Legal Solutions, Financial Compliance, Digital Transformation, and Creative Production. By integrating these core disciplines, the firm delivers comprehensive, future\-focused strategies that are both practical and innovative. Teams at Deutsche work closely with clients to reduce risk, streamline compliance, and build robust digital roadmaps. The company also specializes in crafting compelling brand narratives that strengthen competitive positioning and deliver measurable business value. Professionals joining Deutsche can expect a collaborative environment focused on transforming client challenges into long\-term opportunities.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Graphic Designer will be responsible for creating visual concepts and designs that support Deutsche’s consulting and creative production initiatives. Day\-to\-day tasks include developing brand assets, designing logos and marketing materials, producing graphics for digital and print channels, and ensuring visual consistency across all client and internal projects. The role involves collaborating with consultants, marketers, and digital teams to translate complex ideas into clear, engaging visual stories. The Graphic Designer will participate in brainstorming sessions, prepare design mockups, refine concepts based on feedback, and maintain design files and asset libraries. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Thrissur.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong skills in Graphics and Graphic Design, with the ability to create compelling visual assets for digital and print media.
* Experience in Logo Design and Branding to develop and maintain cohesive brand identities for clients.
* Proficiency in Typography and layout principles to produce clear, readable, and aesthetically balanced designs.
* Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud or equivalent) and basic knowledge of digital production workflows.
* Ability to interpret briefs, collaborate in cross\-functional teams, and present design concepts clearly to stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to handle multiple projects with deadlines.
* Relevant education in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience designing for consulting, corporate, or professional services environments is an advantage.

title: Enterprise User Experience Leader
description:
**About RedBlack** 




 RedBlack is a leading fintech product company specializing in investment management software. Our platform supports portfolio monitoring, rebalancing, tax optimization, trading, order management, and compliance for wealth management firms. RedBlack supports more than $1 trillion in client assets and is known for accuracy, reliability, and innovation in a highly specialized domain.
 



 We build products for complex, high\-value workflows. For us, UX is not cosmetic. It directly affects advisor productivity, operational confidence, decision quality, and customer trust.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As the
 **Enterprise User Experience Leader (UX Lead)** 
 , you will shape how users understand, navigate, and complete sophisticated investment management workflows. You will work across discovery, problem framing, interaction design, prototyping, validation, specification, and delivery support.
 



 This role is suited for a UX professional who can balance user needs, business rules, data complexity, technical constraints, and delivery realities. You will partner closely with Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, QA, and Delivery to create experiences that are intuitive, consistent, scalable, and enterprise\-grade.
 



 You will not simply produce screens. You will clarify workflows, reduce cognitive load, define reusable interaction patterns, improve design quality, and help teams make better product decisions earlier.
 



  





**Who You Are** 



* You are a product\-minded UX designer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems.
* You bring structure to ambiguity and can move from problem discovery to practical design direction.
* You care deeply about usability, clarity, consistency, accessibility, and enterprise\-grade detail.
* You are comfortable designing for business users, power users, operational teams, and data\-rich environments.
* You communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You can defend design decisions with evidence, reasoning, user empathy, and business context.
* You collaborate well, accept feedback constructively, and help raise the quality of the team.
* You balance ideal user experience with technical feasibility, timelines, and product priorities.



  





**What you will do** 



* Lead UX discovery for complex product areas by understanding users, workflows, business rules, pain points, and operational context
* Translate complex investment\-management workflows into clear information architecture, task flows, interaction models, and screen designs
* Create wireframes, prototypes, journey maps, user flows, design specifications, and handoff documentation
* Define intuitive experiences for data\-heavy screens, exception handling, multi\-step workflows, dashboards, forms, tables, and decision\-support interfaces
* Partner with Product Owners and Business Analysts to shape requirements, identify UX risks, and improve problem definition before development begins
* Work closely with engineers to ensure design intent is feasible, implemented accurately, and consistent with front\-end standards
* Use design systems, reusable patterns, and component guidance to improve consistency and delivery efficiency
* Apply accessibility, responsive behavior, usability heuristics, and enterprise design best practices to daily design decisions
* Facilitate design reviews, gather feedback, explain design rationale, and align stakeholders around user\-centered solutions
* Support validation through usability review, stakeholder walkthroughs, product demos, user feedback, and iterative refinement
* Mentor designers and help cross\-functional teams build stronger UX judgment and product thinking


- 


**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in user experience design, including user journey mapping, information architecture, wireframing, and prototyping.
* Experience with user research methods such as interviews, surveys, usability testing, and analysis of behavioral data.
* Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar), and familiarity with design systems.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and business teams, and to present UX concepts and decisions clearly.
* Demonstrated experience leading UX initiatives or teams, with a portfolio showcasing complex, data\-rich applications or fintech products.
* Understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and best practices for web\-based enterprise software.
* Excellent problem\-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills, with attention to detail and a user\-centered mindset.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**What Is a Plus** 



* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or investment technology.
* Experience modernizing legacy enterprise interfaces.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Experience collaborating in a fast\-paced, iterative product environment.



  





**Why Join RedBlack** 



* Shape UX for a sophisticated fintech platform used in high\-value investment management workflows.
* Work on meaningful enterprise product problems where design quality has direct business impact.
* Collaborate with teams that value thoughtful execution, ownership, and product excellence.
* Influence design standards, workflow clarity, and user experience maturity across the platform.
* Benefit from hybrid work, flexible hours, competitive compensation, and a high\-quality office environment.



  





**Contact Recruitment Team:** 
 recruitment\-india@redblacksoftware.com

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Develop visual designs that communicate ideas effectively across digital and marketing channels. The Graphic Designer will work on a variety of creative requirements, including social media posts, promotional materials, website graphics, presentations, and brand assets. The role involves understanding design briefs, developing suitable concepts, refining visuals based on feedback, and ensuring that final designs meet quality and brand standards. Strong creative thinking, visual awareness, attention to detail, and the ability to work within deadlines are essential for this position.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Create creative designs for social media posts, digital campaigns, websites, advertisements, and marketing materials
* Translate concepts and content briefs into visually appealing design layouts
* Develop banners, brochures, presentations, and other communication materials
* Work closely with content, marketing, and creative teams to understand design requirements
* Select suitable typography, imagery, layouts, and visual elements for different design projects
* Resize and adapt creative assets according to the requirements of different platforms
* Review completed designs, incorporate feedback, and make necessary revisions
* Organise and maintain design files, source materials, and final creative assets


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Fine Arts, or a related field
* Minimum 1 year of professional experience in graphic design or a related creative role
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and other relevant graphic design tools
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour, spacing, and visual balance
* Good creative thinking and visual communication skills
